impact.text: dashboards and off-chain accounting that rely on decimals() to format shares can misreport balances and APY.

precondition_sources.text: USDM, the underlying asset, uses 6 decimals.
sUSDM.decimals() is overridden to always return 6.

intent_sources.text: sUSDM.decimals() must equal assetDecimals + _decimalsOffset() (i.e., 12 given USDM's 6 decimals and offset 6), matching ERC-4626 semantics.
